name: Swan Song
oracle_text: Counter target enchantment, instant, or sorcery spell. Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.
blocked_sentences: Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying.

needs.what: a token definition for a 2/2 blue Bird creature token with flying -- id `bird_2_2_u_flying`, name "Bird Token", types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Bird"], colors ["U"], power 2, toughness 2, keywords ["flying"], is_token true -- added to data/cards/tokens.cards.json so `create_token` can name it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `create_token` takes only a `token` id string naming a card already in the pool (src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_board.py op_create_token -> primitives.create_token); there is no inline token body and no size/colour/subtype overrides on the op, and `loader.validate_token_references` raises `references unknown card` at load time for any id that is not present and marked `is_token`, so the card cannot ship ahead of the definition. The pool's only Bird is `bird_1_1_w_flying` in data/cards/isperia.cards.json -- a 1/1 white Bird, wrong power, toughness and colour -- and the only 2/2 blue flier is `illusion_1_1_u_flying`'s neighbour set, none of which is a 2/2 blue Bird. Substituting any of them would make the card hand its victim a different creature than it prints, and a token definition is data the worker may not write.
needs.note: The rest of the card is expressible: `counter` on a `kind: "spell"` target whose selector is `{"any_types": ["Enchantment", "Instant", "Sorcery"]}`, and `create_token` with `controller: {"controller_of_target": "t1"}` for "Its controller".
